question: What is truly said to have been born of Cyavana and to have fallen into the great ocean?
premises: Something born of Cyavana is mentioned.
It is said to have fallen.
A location in the great ocean is specified.
inference: Truly, what was born of Cyavana fell into the great ocean.
uncertainties: The identity of what was born remains implicit.
plain_english: Truly, what was born of Cyavana fell into the great ocean.
